response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS o FROM per WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.o), kavg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.transref, kept.avg_cnt AS average_anlycount, kept.avg_cnt - overall.o AS diff_above_overall, kept.avg_cnt - kavg.k AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept, overall, kavg ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
